name: Phantasmagoric Fog Trap OLD
description: Cloying violet mist billows from the undergrowth, filling the heads of any creatures inside with maddening visions of dark moonless nights, twisted malignant trees, and steaming rivers of blood.
disable: DC 28 Survival (expert) to find a path through the Grand Hall that doesn't disturb the undergrowth

generalAbilities.name: Blow Mists
generalAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature moves through the undergrowth

Effect One round later, the hall fills with violet fog that imposes a -2 circumstance penalty to Perception checks to all creatures within it and exposes anyone who enters it to phantasmagoric fog.

Effect: Phantasmagoric Fog

generalAbilities.name: Phantasmagoric Fog
generalAbilities.description:
Saving Throw DC 24 Will Saving Throw

Maximum Duration 6 rounds

Stage 1 Stupefied 1 (1 round)

Stage 2 Confused and stupefied 1 (1 round)

Stage 3 confused and Stupefied 2 (1 round).
